content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after a crypto payment is a game changer for digital creators. It eliminates the need for intermediaries that charge hefty fees, like Gumroad’s 10% per transaction. With the right infrastructure, creators can sell their products directly to consumers, retaining more revenue. This approach prioritizes sovereignty, allowing creators to maintain full control over their sales and customer data. It’s not just about selling; it’s about building a sustainable business model that thrives in regions often overlooked by mainstream payment processors.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The backbone of automated ebook delivery is a combination of free tools that work seamlessly together. Hosting can be done through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, providing a reliable platform for your store. The backend logic is powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which handles the order processing and file delivery. When a customer makes a payment using NOWPayments, the order is registered, and an automatic webhook triggers the delivery of the ebook through services like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This architecture ensures that transactions are efficient, secure, and immediate.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in countries facing payment barriers. Whether you’re selling ebooks, courses, or digital templates, this infrastructure caters to those who refuse to be held back by restrictions of traditional payment processors. It empowers creators in regions like Ghana, Kenya, and Cameroon to operate independently without recurring fees or platform dependencies. By leveraging this architecture, digital creators can build a resilient business model that withstands financial isolation.
Automated delivery means your customers get their products instantly.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The automated delivery system is composed of several key components. First, a hosting solution like GitHub Pages offers a stable environment for your digital store. Next, backend logic is facilitated by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which allows for dynamic interactions with customers. NOWPayments processes payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, ensuring higher profit margins. Storage and delivery are managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, allowing for quick access to purchased products. Together, these components form a cohesive system that streamlines the sales process.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your automated ebook delivery system, start by selecting your hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Store your ebooks in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for easy access. Finally, configure the automatic webhook for seamless delivery once payments are confirmed. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from COREMERCH, which includes all necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack. This involves using platforms like GitHub Pages for hosting, integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, and automating delivery through backend scripts. This method allows you to retain more of your earnings and maintain control over your sales process.
Retain more revenue with a lower fee structure compared to traditional platforms.

If you're looking to build a digital store that operates independently of restrictive platforms, explore related searches to learn more about selling digital downloads using crypto. Our Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything you need to deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without relying on Gumroad or Payhip by creating your own online store using a combination of free hosting and payment solutions that support cryptocurrency.
How do I ensure automated delivery of my ebooks?

Automated delivery of your ebooks can be ensured by integrating backend logic that responds to payment confirmations. Using services like Google Drive for storage and backend scripts to manage delivery is key.
What cryptocurrencies can I use for payment processing?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to choose from a wide range of options for your customers. This flexibility caters to diverse payment preferences.
